description: This source file implements context parallelism and attention-specific utilities for PyTorch's distributed training, including sharding, custom attention mechanisms, and load balancing features within the torch.distributed.tensor.experimental module.

classes.name: _CausalBehavior
classes.description: Enum representing the behavior of causal masking in attention, indicating whether to skip, not apply, or apply causal masking.

classes.name: _RotateMethod
classes.description: Enum for selecting the rotation method used in ring attention implementations, either ALL_TO_ALL or ALL_GATHER.

classes.name: _DispatchMode
classes.description: Enum to define the dispatch mode for attention operations, either MONKEY_PATCH or MODULE_WRAPPER.

classes.name: _ContextParallel
classes.description: Class for managing context parallelism, including registration hooks for different attention types (FLEX or SDPA).

methods.name: _CausalBehavior _is_causal_behavior( rank: int, world_size: int, i: int, is_causal: bool )
methods.description: Determines how causal attention should be applied per rank based on load balancing.

methods.name: torch.Tensor _maybe_wait(tensor: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Waits on an AsyncCollectiveTensor if applicable, else returns the tensor directly.

methods.name: torch.Tensor _partial_update( original: torch.Tensor, new: torch.Tensor, dim: int, n_chunks: int, idx: int, add: bool, )
methods.description: Partially updates a tensor chunk along a specified dimension, either adding or replacing it.

methods.name: object _sdpa_handler( op_call: torch._ops.OpOverload, args: tuple[object, ...], kwargs: dict[str, object], )
methods.description: Dispatches a scaled dot-product attention operation based on the overload, managing sharding propagation.

methods.name: Generator[None,None,None] context_parallel( mesh: DeviceMesh, *, buffers: list[torch.Tensor] | None = None, buffer_seq_dims: list[int] | None = None, no_restore_buffers: set[torch.Tensor] | None = None, )
methods.description: Context manager for enabling context parallelism, which patches attention functions and shards input buffers.

methods.name: list[torch.Tensor] context_parallel_unshard( mesh: DeviceMesh, buffers: list[torch.Tensor], seq_dims: list[int], load_balancer: _LoadBalancer | None = None, )
methods.description: Unshards buffers that were sharded during context parallelism to restore their original form.

methods.name: set_rotate_method
methods.description: Sets the rotation method ('allgather' or 'alltoall') for ring attention operations.
